result.standard: NICE guidelines on prevalence, timing and content of follow-up after self-harm or suicidality

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Abstract gives recommendations only; no results reported.

result.setting: Acute psychiatric unit in a general hospital (Cork)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 46.5% of admissions occurred during normal working hours; out-of-hours admissions more likely under 45 years.

result.other_findings: Stays over 4 weeks more likely in single patients.

result.setting: General adult psychiatrists in the Republic of Ireland (questionnaire)
result.standard: American Psychiatric Association 1997 guidelines and UK old age psychiatrist practice

cycle1.result: Median doses in keeping with APA guidelines; 10% specified at least one dosage regime grossly outside recommended ranges.

result.other_findings: Sedative typical antipsychotics were still the most frequently chosen for behavioural symptoms.

result.topic: Organisational factors and emergency laparotomy mortality
result.setting: 185 hospitals in the National Emergency Laparotomy Audit
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Perioperative care pathways (OR 0.86 and 0.89) and emergency surgical units (OR 0.89 and 0.89) linked to lower 30- and 90-day mortality; infrequent consultant intraoperative care linked to higher mortality (OR 1.61).

result.other_findings: Postoperative geriatric review linked to much lower mortality in patients aged 70 or over (OR 0.35 at 30 days).

result.setting: One oncology outpatient service and one palliative care outpatient and inpatient service, Sydney
result.standard: Australian guidelines for cancer pain management; feasibility thresholds of 75% screening and median 30 minutes per audit

cycle1.result: 95% (n = 429) of 452 visits screened; median audit time 37.5 minutes (31 records); adherence to indicators ranged from 63% (pain assessment at first presentation) to 94% (regular pain assessment and regular medication).

result.other_findings: Electronic pain screening was technically challenging and time-intensive for nurses.

result.setting: Fifteen general practices in Victoria
result.standard: Women on GDM registers completing a diabetes screening test and prevention planning consultation within 15 months (guideline-led)

cycle1.result: Diabetes screening 26%; postpartum screening 43%; prevention planning consultations 0%; BMI recorded 51%.

result.intervention: 12-month quality improvement collaborative with quarterly audits, guideline-led workshops and PDSA feedback cycles.

cycle2.result: Diabetes screening 61%; postpartum screening 60%; prevention planning consultations 10%; BMI recorded 69%.

result.other_findings: Number of women with normal BMI did not improve.

result.setting: 25 of 26 paediatric surgical centres in the UK and Ireland (BAPS CASS national audit)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 113 (93%) of 121 bladder outlet obstruction cases due to PUV; PUV incidence 1/3800; presentation antenatal 35%, infancy 42%, late 23%.

result.other_findings: Antenatally diagnosed boys had higher creatinine and more renal dysplasia.

result.topic: COPD diagnosis accuracy on primary care registers
result.setting: Welsh general practices on the QOF COPD register (63% of practices)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Of 8957 patients with post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC coded, 75% (n = 6702) had compatible spirometry and 25% (n = 2255) did not.

result.other_findings: Only 19% of 48 105 register patients had post-bronchodilator spirometry coded.

result.setting: Four surgical wards, St Vincent's Public Hospital, Sydney (tertiary referral hospital)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Oxycodone tablets rising by 1.8 tablets/100 surgical admissions per month; 27% of oxycodone prescriptions inappropriate.

result.intervention: Five sequential interventions; the fifth was audit-feedback plus individual academic detailing.

cycle2.result: Tablets fell by 77 per 100 surgical cases after the fifth intervention, then a monthly fall of 3.2 tablets/100 admissions; inappropriate prescriptions fell to 17% (p = 0.048) and then 10% (p = 0.002) after 3 years.

result.other_findings: The first four interventions produced no significant change.

result.setting: Hospitals in Quebec (QUARISMA cluster randomised trial)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: No significant effect on trial of labour (adjusted OR 1.22, P = 0.11) or VBAC (adjusted OR 1.20, P = 0.10) in women with one previous caesarean.

result.intervention: Audits of caesarean indications, feedback to professionals and best-practice implementation.
result.other_findings: Trial of labour fell in women with more than one previous caesarean (adjusted OR 0.38); no effect on morbidity.

result.setting: Global electronic survey of healthcare professionals (over 10 countries)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 23% of institutions routinely offered pre-operative meetings with people with a tracheostomy; 31% consistently provided full nursing and equipment needs on discharge.

result.other_findings: Only half of institutions took part in tracheostomy QI, and under a third of these involved patients.

result.setting: Multisite academic family health team, Toronto
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Transgender patients less often screened than cisgender patients for cervical (56% vs 72%) and breast (33% vs 65%) cancer.

result.other_findings: Colorectal screening also lower after adjustment (adjusted OR 0.50).

result.setting: Five ITU settings in NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 633 cases (214 with previous epilepsy, 419 de novo); admission mortality 13.8% for de novo vs 7.5% with previous epilepsy.

result.other_findings: Substance misuse contributed in 52% of de novo cases and 33.7% of cases with previous epilepsy.

result.setting: Rural and remote antenatal services, Western Australia
result.standard: Screening for gestational diabetes with OGTT in second or third trimester

cycle1.result: 278 (50.5%) screened with OGTT; 113 (20.5%) had no record of any GDM screening.

result.other_findings: Aboriginal women were less likely to be screened; GDM rate 14.7% among those screened vs 7.4% state-wide.

result.other_findings: Review of applications, methods and ethical-legal issues of surgical video recording.

result.standard: European SEDENTEXCT guidelines for CBCT justification

cycle1.result: 94% compliance with SEDENTEXCT.

result.other_findings: Service evaluation of 50 records: 44% of treatment plans changed because of CBCT information.

result.topic: Airway management in children with halo orthoses
result.setting: Great Ormond Street Hospital, London
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 269 anaesthetic records from 90 children; multiple intubation attempts in 3.4% (1/29) at halo placement vs 15.1% (11/73) with halo in situ.

result.other_findings: Cormack and Lehane grade 3 or 4 more common with halo in situ.

result.setting: 15 antenatal centres nationally, Republic of Ireland
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Women poorly prepared for pregnancy, with lapses in pre-pregnancy care and retinal screening; 156 (84.3%) live births; 103 (65.5%) caesarean; 58 (36.9%) infants large for gestational age.

result.other_findings: 122 (65.9%) had type 1 and 56 (30.3%) type 2 diabetes.

result.topic: Adverse childhood experiences and child deaths
result.setting: Child death overview panel, North West England
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 20% of 489 cases had 4 or more ACEs; these deaths were 22.26 (5.72-86.59) times more likely to be 'avoidable and non-natural'.

result.other_findings: Children with 4 or more ACEs were 3.44 times more likely to die from 'chronic and acute conditions'.

result.setting: Intensive care units in the Wessex region (SPARC collaborative)
result.standard: Tidal volumes of 6-8 ml per kg ideal body weight

cycle1.result: Adherence to lung protective ventilation variable across units (figures not reported).

result.intervention: Regional quality improvement project: accurate recording of weight and height and a simple chart to calculate tidal volume.

cycle2.result: Average 30% higher duration of ventilation within target tidal volume (1843 hours of ventilation audited over both years).

result.other_findings: Started from a local audit of weight recording and a regional survey.

result.topic: Motor neuron disease care data completeness
result.setting: National Scottish MND care (CARE-MND electronic platform)
result.standard: NICE recommendations for MND care data fields

cycle1.result: Data field completion ranged from 4 to 95%, median 50%.

result.intervention: Standardised national electronic data platform (CARE-MND) integrating audit and research fields.

cycle2.result: Data capture ranged from 32 to 98%, median 87%; 15/17 fields significantly more complete.

result.other_findings: Platform has enabled national audits of MND care and harmonised service protocols.

result.setting: Australian Immunisation Register, New South Wales
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Estimated true full vaccination coverage at one year 96.2% vs AIR reported 94.1%; 34.9% of children reported as overdue were fully vaccinated.

result.other_findings: Provider upload errors and duplicate records caused incorrect coverage recording.

result.setting: Tertiary ICU, Prince of Wales Hospital, Hong Kong
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: VV-ECMO RESP-SMR 1.16 (95% CI 0.44-1.88); VA-ECMO SAVE-SMR 0.69 (95% CI 0.39-0.98).

result.other_findings: APACHE II underestimated mortality in lower-risk and overestimated it in high-risk VA-ECMO patients.

result.topic: Anaesthetic technique and unplanned ICU admission after lung resection
result.setting: 16 thoracic surgical centres in the UK (ACTACC national audit)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 253 of 11,208 (2.3%) had unplanned ICU admission; TIVA (OR 0.50) and epidural (OR 0.56) linked to fewer admissions.

result.other_findings: Unplanned ICU admission linked to mortality of 29.00% vs 0.03% and longer stay (26 vs 6 days).

result.setting: Large oncology centre, Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 82% from lung, breast and melanoma primaries; half received treatment, of whom 39% had whole-brain radiotherapy and 40% stereotactic radiosurgery.

result.other_findings: Commonest admission reasons were headache, seizures, weakness and confusion.

result.setting: Paediatric diabetes service with clinics in five local secondary schools (Newcastle)
result.standard: National Paediatric Diabetes Audit (NPDA) standards

cycle1.result: 9/17 frequent non-attenders not seen at least once in 3 months.

result.intervention: Quarterly school-based diabetes clinics with a nurse and physician from January 2017.

cycle2.result: Hospital WNB rate fell by 50% in the intervention group; patients not seen at least once in 3 months fell to 1/17.

result.other_findings: Uncovered knowledge gaps, emotional difficulties and issues such as poor school attendance and bullying.

result.setting: Australian cancer services (cross-sectional survey of 83 services)
result.standard: Australian evidence-based distress management guidelines

cycle1.result: About 38% of services never or rarely screen; 52% of those that screen do so for all patients; 34% follow referral protocols.

result.other_findings: Main barriers were resources to act on results (74%), lack of time (67%) and lack of training (66%).

result.setting: Paediatric trainee collaboratives in the West Midlands, Wales and Peninsula
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: not reported

result.topic: Time to endoscopy in upper GI bleeding
result.setting: 20 centres (trainee-led multicentre audit, West and East Midlands)
result.standard: Endoscopy within 24 h of admission (national quality standard)

cycle1.result: Median time to endoscopy 21.2 h (IQR 12.0-35.7); early endoscopy in 58.9% (range 31.0-87.5% by centre).

result.other_findings: Early endoscopy linked to shorter stay (median 1 day) but not 30-day mortality; delayed referral predicted delay.

result.topic: Congenital heart surgery outcomes and infection
result.setting: Paediatric cardiology and cardiovascular surgery centre, São José do Rio Preto (IQIC database)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Significant decreases in surgical site infection (P = .03), bacterial sepsis and other infections, with reduced mortality despite rising case complexity.

result.setting: 127 Acute Medical Units across the UK (SAMBA18)
result.standard: Clinical quality indicators and NHS Improvement standards

cycle1.result: not reported

result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 28 (7%) of 390 referrals diagnosed with head and neck cancer; positive predictive value 17% in least deprived vs 6% in most deprived.

result.other_findings: Cancer rates higher in dentist referrals (p = 0.02); 62% of referrals lived in the most deprived quintile.

result.topic: Chronic kidney disease coding in primary care
result.setting: General practices in four East London clinical commissioning groups
result.standard: National CKD audit coding (average 70%); blood pressure to target and statin prescribing

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Practice-based facilitation with shared data, clinical targets, financial incentives and education as part of renal service redesign.

cycle2.result: Three intervention CCGs showed significant coding improvement (p values truncated in abstract).

result.other_findings: Controlled comparison with a non-intervention CCG.

result.topic: Neurological outcome reporting after in-hospital cardiac arrest
result.setting: Acute hospitals participating in the UK National Cardiac Arrest Audit (195 hospitals)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Of 6093 survivors, 5492 (90.1%) had CPC and information source reported: case note review 3989 (72.6%), communication with clinical team 1053 (19.2%), direct patient assessment 450 (8.2%). 96.6% had good neurological outcome (CPC 1 or 2).

result.other_findings: Differences in reported CPC between information sources were small and not clinically important.

result.topic: ICNARC score prediction of outcomes after cardiac surgery
result.setting: Single tertiary referral cardiac surgery centre (Castle Hill Hospital)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: ICNARC C-indices: 0.840 in-hospital mortality, 0.858 renal failure, 0.665 pulmonary complications, 0.764 gastrointestinal complications, 0.702 neurological complications, 0.654 confusion, 0.885 multiorgan failure.

result.other_findings: Authors suggest ICNARC can be used as an early warning screening tool for postoperative organ failure.

result.topic: Re-excision of close or involved margins in oral cancer
result.setting: Maxillofacial unit (Aintree University Hospital)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Margins clear in 213 (33%), close in 314 (49%), involved in 113 (18%). Re-excision rates 7 (2.2%) close and 12 (10.6%) involved. Local recurrence 5.2% clear, 10.7% non-re-excised close, 8.9% involved.

result.other_findings: No re-excised close margins contained residual cancer; four re-excised involved margins did.

result.setting: 28 cardiothoracic centres across the UK and Ireland (Association of Cardiothoracic Anaesthesia and Critical Care national audit)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 17 major complications (palatal injury or gastro-oesophageal disruption) in 22,314 examinations: incidence 0.08% (95%CI 0.05-0.13%), about 1:1300. Seven deaths attributed: 0.03% (95%CI 0.01-0.07%), about 1:3000.

result.other_findings: Most complications occurred in patients without known risk factors; authors recommend review of probe insertion technique and patient information.

result.setting: Department of General Surgery, Wexford General Hospital; surgical inpatients
result.standard: Consensus guideline on indications for PPI use (Scarpignato et al, 2016)

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Radiotherapy dosimetry audit for lung SBRT trial
result.setting: Twelve radiotherapy centres in the EORTC LungTech trial
result.standard: EORTC 22113-08113 LungTech trial radiotherapy quality assurance protocol

cycle1.result: Reference output dose median variation 0.5% [-1.1, +1.5]. Chamber vs planned dose median deviation 1.8% (7.5 mm static), 1.1% (12.5 mm static), 3.2% (dynamic). Film gamma median pass rates 92.0%, 96.2% and 71.0% (7.5 mm dynamic).

result.other_findings: Dynamic irradiations had significantly lower gamma pass rates than the 12.5 mm static plan (p = 0.001); total monitor units correlated with results.

result.setting: National meningitis audit, Botswana
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 30.4% (2067/6796) had abnormal CSF; 10% (651/6796) had a confirmed microbiological diagnosis: Cryptococcus 26.9% (175/651), S. pneumoniae 18.9% (123/651), H. influenzae 20.3% (132/651), M. tuberculosis 1.1% (7/651).

result.other_findings: No HiB meningitis diagnosed in 2013-2014 after HiB vaccination; cryptococcal meningitis incidence 1.3 per 100,000 person-years.

result.topic: Partial nephrectomy for T1 renal tumours
result.setting: Hospitals contributing to the British Association of Urological Surgeons Nephrectomy Audit
result.standard: European Association of Urology guideline on surgical management of T1 renal tumours

cycle1.result: Partial nephrectomy use increased from 39.7% in 2012 to 44.9% in 2016. PADUA score documented in 39% of cases after March 2016. Missing complication data 8.5-9%.

result.other_findings: Proportion treated with partial nephrectomy rose with hospital volume (from 18.1% in the lowest-volume centres), with an inverse association between volume and complications.

result.setting: James Paget University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: Standards of care for CAP including CURB65 documentation and empirical antibiotic prescribing guidelines

cycle1.result: CURB65 score documented in 32/62; chest X-ray findings documented in 59/62; 85.5% compliant with antibiotic prescribing guidelines.

result.intervention: Multidisciplinary approach to CAP management (involving pharmacy and microbiology)
result.other_findings: Authors state the multidisciplinary approach considerably improved compliance with most standards, but no earlier figures are given in the abstract.

result.setting: Single hospital (Glasgow Royal Infirmary), acute asthma admissions
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 157/194 admissions (81%) studied. 114 treated with oral corticosteroids, only 70 had maintenance treatment increased at discharge, 107 had follow-up booked (average three and a half weeks).

result.other_findings: After discharge 54 reported regular sleep disturbance, 78 morning chest tightness and 77 wheeze on stairs; most did not understand their drugs or have an action plan.

result.topic: Risk adjustment for complications after head and neck cancer surgery
result.setting: Two UK NHS institutions
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Predicted and observed complication rates both 43%; discrimination fair (ROC 0.66-0.68).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.standard: not reported

result.other_findings: Results used to start UK audit of 5 of the 9 morbidities, local monitoring software and parent information.

cycle1.result: Myofascial pain: clinically significant relief at three months in 95% (20/21) and at six months in 62% (13/21). Visceral pain: transient benefit of two to three weeks in one-third (6/17).

result.topic: Nutrition support for malnourished community adults
result.setting: Southampton Community Prescribing Support Service (dietitians)
result.standard: NICE CG32 standards 1.3.1 (indications for nutrition support) and 1.5.6 (monitoring); target 100% compliance

cycle1.result: Compliance with standard 1.3.1 was 46% and with standard 1.5.6 82%.

result.other_findings: 86% (n = 13) of patients reported satisfaction (target 90%); nationally 89% of dietitians used weight and 87% BMI as outcomes.

result.setting: Eastman Dental Hospital restorative dentistry referrals
result.standard: British Society of Periodontology referral criteria: all patients should have initial periodontal therapy before referral

cycle1.result: All 100 referrals incomplete; 12 had BPE scores matching those at consultation; 85 patients reported oral hygiene instruction and 91 root surface debridement before referral.

result.other_findings: Most referrers gave no diagnosis and used incorrect terminology; 25 dentists reported more initial therapy than patients did.

result.topic: Transfusion practice in sickle cell disease
result.setting: 84 hospitals in the UK and Republic of Ireland
result.standard: Standards and guidelines for transfusion services in sickle cell disease

cycle1.result: 4528 transfusion episodes, 84% elective; stroke prevention 42% of transfusions; 60% (732/1227) needed Rh CE negative blood; adults 50% automated red cell exchange, children 87% simple transfusion.

result.other_findings: Paucity of clinical management protocols, trained staff and network arrangements.

result.topic: Representativeness of cancer patient experience survey in lung cancer
result.setting: National Lung Cancer Audit population linked with the English Cancer Patient Experience Survey
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 15,967 (7%) were included in CPES; 96% of respondents received anti-cancer treatment vs 56% nationally (adjusted OR 10.3, 95% CI 9.4-11.2).

result.other_findings: CPES under-represented older, more deprived patients and those with worse performance status, comorbidity or emergency diagnosis.

result.setting: General internal medicine services at 3 academic hospitals (McMaster University, Hamilton, Ontario)
result.standard: Discharge medication reconciliation quality audit tool (Canadian Patient Safety Institute and ISMP Canada), modified

cycle1.result: Documentation of any discharge medication reconciliation for only 1 patient (3%); none carried out by pharmacists.

result.other_findings: Post-discharge interviews showed major communication gaps with community pharmacists and family physicians.

result.setting: 11 English sites across clinical settings
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Outcome measures (IPOS-Dem, Phase of Illness, AKPS, FAST) completed at first assessment for 225 people with dementia across nine sites.

result.other_findings: Recording non-physical symptoms by proxy was challenging.

result.setting: Tertiary urology department (Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 334 of 2773 scheduled operations (12%) cancelled at the last minute.

result.intervention: Targeted interventions including a reminder telephone call covering admission instructions

cycle2.result: Modest reduction (0.2%) in the last-minute cancellation rate.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: 85 UK radiology departments with an emergency department (major trauma centres, trauma units and others)
result.standard: National guidelines for imaging and reporting in major trauma

cycle1.result: 240 (11%) scans had a primary survey report documented, 53 (22%) of which were unavailable after 20 minutes; final consultant report within 1 hour for 1,033 (48%) and within 2 hours for a further 540 (25%).

result.other_findings: 63% of scans were out of hours; 40% of departments rely on registrars out of hours with consultant report next day.

result.setting: Ten hospitals in seven European nations (PaBloE working group)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Almost all hospitals had preoperative anaemia pathways, but only two nations had national guidelines; anaesthetists organised management in six of ten hospitals; iron deficiency mostly treated with intravenous iron.

result.other_findings: Survey of organisation rather than audit of patient care.

result.setting: Seven hospitals in the East of England; elective day case general and vascular surgery
result.standard: National guidelines: all people with diabetes should have HbA1c within 6 months before surgery, below 69 mmol/mol if safe

cycle1.result: 86.7% (157/181) had HbA1c tested within 6 months; 8.9% (14/157) had HbA1c ≥ 69 mmol/mol and 85.7% (12/14) of these proceeded to surgery without optimisation.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: TURBT quality and bladder cancer guideline adherence
result.setting: Urology Department, The Pennine Acute Hospitals NHS Trust
result.standard: Guidelines on management of non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (single instillation chemotherapy, re-TUR timing)

cycle1.result: Detrusor muscle absent in 22.8% of initial TURBT specimens; single instillation chemotherapy given to only 40% of eligible patients; 54.3% had re-TUR, on average 10 weeks after TURBT; 3-month recurrence 36.0%.

result.other_findings: Tumours over 3 cm and carcinoma in situ predicted early recurrence.

result.setting: ENT Department, Warrington and Halton NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 27 of 100 epistaxis admissions were taking atorvastatin and 21 simvastatin; none of 24 ENT registrars knew epistaxis is a listed common side effect of atorvastatin.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Eye care for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people
result.setting: Aboriginal Community Controlled Health Services and regional eye care stakeholders, Katherine region, Northern Territory
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Clinical audit of primary eye checks, ophthalmology referrals and spectacle prescriptions; baseline figures not given in the abstract.

result.intervention: Increased service delivery, primary eye care training for staff, updated primary care templates and a regional eye care coalition group

cycle2.result: Recorded optometry examinations, spectacles prescribed and annual dilated fundus examinations in diabetes increased; fewer patients with diabetes had never had an eye examination. No figures given.

result.other_findings: Stakeholders perceived a marked improvement in the regional eye care system.

result.setting: Antenatal services across London (NHS England London Region)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 27.1% of bookings were before 10 weeks' gestation and 72.8% by 12 + 6 weeks.

result.other_findings: Late booking was associated with living in more deprived areas; post-referral delays compound late referral for some women.

result.setting: Surrey and Sussex Healthcare NHS Trust; staff with Safeguarding Children Level 3 certificate
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Group 1 (traditional training) reported 64% experience of reporting.

result.intervention: Changed safeguarding training with a broader range of speakers giving shorter, more personal and focused presentations

cycle2.result: Group 2 (n = 100) 43% and group 3 (n = 76) 51% experience of reporting; more barriers to reporting with the new training and less appropriate scenario responses in group 3.

result.other_findings: Commonest barrier was uncertainty of diagnosis; personalised training was less effective.

result.setting: Members of the American College of Radiology International Economics Committee representing 12 countries
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Imaging appropriateness and disease registries reported by 91.7%, KPIs and M&M rounds 83.3%, quality audits and critical incident reporting 58.3%, Lean/Kaizen and physician performance assessment 25.0%.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Adjuvant chemotherapy for stage II colon cancer
result.setting: Bi-National Colorectal Cancer Audit database
result.standard: Current guideline recommendations on adjuvant chemotherapy for high-risk stage II colon cancer

cycle1.result: 715 of 3763 (19%) patients with stage II colon cancer were offered chemotherapy.

result.other_findings: Regional patients may be less likely to receive guideline-concordant offers; many patients were not discussed at MDT.

result.topic: Physical health monitoring in adolescent psychiatric inpatients
result.setting: General adolescent inpatient unit (Oxford Health NHS Foundation Trust)
result.standard: Local and national standards for physical health monitoring and medication monitoring

cycle1.result: Compliance with medication monitoring and management of some physical health domains was zero at baseline.

result.intervention: Dedicated wellbeing (physical health) clinic established, refined through PDSA cycles

cycle2.result: Compliance rose to 100% in all but one area; time taken for initial investigations dropped.

result.other_findings: Audits also at 6 and 18 months showed progressive improvement.

result.topic: Oxygen desaturation during paediatric anaesthetic induction
result.setting: Royal Hospital for Sick Children, Yorkhill, Glasgow
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Saturation fell below 90% in 29 children (26.8%) and below 80% in 7 (6.4%).

result.other_findings: Desaturation was commoner under one year, without premedication and in anxious children; none below 90% with inhalational induction.

result.setting: Royal Hospital for Sick Children, Yorkhill, Glasgow
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 56 children became hypoxaemic (saturation below 90%) at some stage.

result.other_findings: Late hypoxaemia was reduced by supplemental oxygen; saturation on return to the ward was lower than preoperatively (p less than 0.001).

result.topic: Cervical cancer radiotherapy delineation and planning variation
result.setting: 11 UK radiotherapy centres
result.standard: EMBRACE II dose planning aims

cycle1.result: All centres met EMBRACE II aims for PTV V95 and high-risk CTV D90 EQD2 despite variation in dose, fractionation and technique.

result.other_findings: Target volume delineations varied with contouring protocols and parametrial tissue inclusion.

result.setting: Scottish and English general practices (national audit)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 71.5% presented to GPs; 37.4% referred via Urgent-Suspected Cancer route; median primary care interval 5 days (IQR 0-23) and diagnostic interval 30 days (IQR 13-68).

result.other_findings: Intervals were longest for the most remote patients and those with more comorbidities.

result.topic: Sexual health services for men in prison
result.setting: Nurse-led prison sexual health service (South Eastern Health & Social Care Trust)
result.standard: National sexual health outcome measures

cycle1.result: 12 chlamydia-positive (7% positivity) and 3 gonorrhoea-positive results; 2 new syphilis cases; 7 hepatitis C and 3 hepatitis B cases. National outcome measures exceeded for some clinical outcomes.

result.intervention: Nurse-led asymptomatic STI testing service with a promotional animation video
result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Intravenous iron infusion protocol and skin staining
result.setting: University Maternity Hospital Limerick
result.standard: Recommended IV iron infusion protocol, including informing patients of skin staining risk

cycle1.result: 53% of staff compliant with the recommended IV iron infusion protocol; 46% informed patients of skin staining risk. No skin staining or severe adverse reactions over eight weeks.

result.intervention: Education, new infusion protocol and patient information leaflet (developed after two skin staining incidents)
result.other_findings: Self-report survey of 25 staff: 92% flushed cannula before and 88% after infusion, 76% informed patients of staining risk; 15 patients gave largely positive feedback.

result.setting: Acute oncology inpatient admissions at eight hospitals (national audit by medical student network)
result.standard: All patients should be invited to discuss resuscitation within 24 hours of admission

cycle1.result: Resuscitation discussions documented in 43.1% of admissions, 64.0% of these within 24 hours (27.6% of all admissions).

result.other_findings: 6.5% had a DNACPR order before admission, more often in palliative than curative patients (8.5% vs 0.39%).

result.setting: Nine hospitals in Illawarra Shoalhaven Local Health District
result.standard: Patients weighed on admission and during admission

cycle1.result: Only 20.3% weighed on admission; approximately 62.4% weighed at least once during admission.

result.other_findings: Rehabilitation ward patients (OR 5.98), independently mobile patients (OR 2.34) and longer length of stay (OR 1.05) had higher odds of being weighed.

result.topic: Potentially inappropriate medication prescribing in older ED patients
result.setting: Veterans Affairs emergency departments (EQUIPPED programme)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Development of an electronic audit and feedback dashboard to replace in-person academic detailing
result.other_findings: Describes dashboard development; key components were KPIs, peer benchmarking, patient drill down, educational decision support and longitudinal tracking. To be tested in a randomised trial.

result.setting: NHS hospitals in the Northern Deanery
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 2828 in-hospital deaths within 30 days (11.6%); 30-day mortality fell from 16.3% (2001-04) to 8.1% (2013-16).

result.other_findings: Unclear whether the National Emergency Laparotomy Audit has had a measurable effect on 30-day mortality.

result.topic: Day case tonsillectomy unplanned admission and readmission
result.setting: Children's Health Ireland at Temple Street, Dublin (new paediatric day case programme)
result.standard: ENT UK and Royal College of Surgeons maximum acceptable unplanned admission/readmission rate of 15%

cycle1.result: 6/34 (17.6%) admitted from day ward or readmitted within 30 days (95% CI 4.8%-30.5%, p = 0.33, not significantly above 15%).

result.other_findings: Four readmissions (11.8%) were for bleeding, one for nausea and poor intake, one for sleep apnoea concerns; anaesthetic techniques varied considerably.

result.setting: Tertiary neonatal ICU, South Tees NHS Trust
result.standard: Unplanned extubation rate per 100 ventilation days (quality and safety measure)

cycle1.result: 7.2 unplanned extubations per 100 ventilation days.

result.intervention: Sequential interventions: standardised endotracheal tube fixation, regular fixation checks, two-person care technique and adverse event reporting

cycle2.result: 1.4 unplanned extubations per 100 ventilated days (80% reduction).

result.other_findings: Main causes at baseline were loose fixation and giving care without assistance.

result.setting: Asthma mini-clinic in a general practice
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Only slight improvement in outcome among children attending the mini-clinic compared with 31 matched controls from a neighbouring practice.

result.other_findings: Mini-clinic children needed considerably more respiratory consultations than comparison children.

result.topic: Radiology in cancer multidisciplinary team meetings
result.setting: Imaging departments in 145 hospitals (national RCR audit)
result.standard: Royal College of Radiologists standards for cancer MDT meetings

cycle1.result: 145/191 (76%) hospitals responded. Comprehensive radiology MDTM attendance 52-65%; supplementary report of staging/treatment plan 15-26%; late additions discussed without prior imaging review 44-77%.

result.other_findings: 13% of radiologists had no programmed activity for MDTMs; discrepancies were well documented (92-94%) and presented at discrepancy meetings (70-81%).

result.topic: Clinical coding accuracy in military medical surveillance
result.setting: Role 1 Medical Treatment Facility, Camp Shafa, Exercise Saif Sareea 3
result.standard: Accurate EpiNATO-2 / EpiNATO-2 PLUS coding

cycle1.result: Coding errors 12.9% for EpiNATO-2 and 19.4% for EpiNATO-2 PLUS.

result.intervention: Education session and EpiNATO-2 PLUS Summary Guide

cycle2.result: Coding errors 6.8% for EpiNATO-2 and 6.6% for EpiNATO-2 PLUS.

result.other_findings: Across 1163 consultations, EpiNATO-2 PLUS captured an additional 169 patient contacts (about 10% more workload) than EpiNATO-2.

result.topic: Cancer diagnostic intervals in primary care
result.setting: 73 Scottish general practices (Scottish National Cancer Audit)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Rural patients did not have higher odds of prolonged diagnostic intervals than urban patients.

result.other_findings: Rural patients were more likely to have an alarm feature and three or more consultations before referral; rural GPs more often perceived avoidable delay.

result.setting: UK gynaecological cancer centre, Somerset NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Ten recurrences; five-year disease-specific survival 97.3%. Health service saving £116 403 (median £988.60 per patient); patients saved £7122.

result.other_findings: All vault and pelvic recurrences were salvaged; three distant recurrences died.

result.setting: 12 familial cancer clinics (nationwide)
result.standard: Lynch syndrome risk management guidelines

cycle1.result: Clinic files of 464 carriers audited across three periods; baseline figures not given in abstract.

result.intervention: Release of national risk management guidelines

cycle2.result: Documentation increased significantly for only two of eight risk management strategies. Carrier uptake post-guideline: colonoscopy 87%, hysterectomy 68%, aspirin 67%, salpingo-oophorectomy 63%.

result.other_findings: 215 carriers interviewed; interrater agreement k = 0.89.

result.setting: 23 UK cardiac surgical centres (ACTACC national audit)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Resternotomy rate 3.6% (95% CI 3.37-3.85), range 0.69% to 7.6% between centres; mortality after resternotomy 15.0%.

result.other_findings: 89.3% transfused red cells; renal replacement therapy 23.4%; median ICU stay 5 days.

result.topic: In-hospital cardiac arrest rates after the Tracey judgment
result.setting: 115 hospitals in the National Cardiac Arrest Audit
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 21 785 IHCAs pre-judgment; rate declining before the judgment.

cycle2.result: 21 324 IHCAs post-judgment, with an abrupt significant rise in rate immediately after the judgment.

result.other_findings: Proportion of resuscitation attempts deemed futile decreased after the judgment.

result.topic: Upper limb rehabilitation pathway after acquired brain injury
result.setting: Residential rehabilitation unit for children and young people, The Children's Trust, Tadworth
result.standard: Appropriate upper limb assessment form per clinical pathway

cycle1.result: 70% of CYP had an appropriate assessment form.

result.intervention: Clinical pathway (assessment decision tree, intervention matrix, evidence summaries) with multimodal knowledge translation over PDSA cycles
result.other_findings: Staff survey showed increased knowledge and use of the pathway and fewer perceived training needs.

result.setting: Seven acute hospitals in North West England
result.standard: Bundle of process metrics for emergency ARLD care

cycle1.result: Three of seven hospitals were mortality outliers; adjusted odds of death higher at outliers (OR 2.13, 95% CI 1.32-3.44).

result.intervention: Regional QI programme with serial audit of a process bundle

cycle2.result: No outlier hospitals; odds of death 67% lower at original outlier hospitals, unchanged elsewhere.

result.other_findings: Process audit performance of outliers was worse at baseline but improved after the intervention.

result.setting: Two VA Community Living Centers (nursing homes)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Adapted implementation strategies: leader and staff training, local adaptation, audit and feedback, facilitation
result.other_findings: Formative qualitative evaluation; incremental implementation improved frontline staff capability, opportunity and motivation.

result.topic: Emergency laparotomy outcomes in older patients
result.setting: National Emergency Laparotomy Audit hospitals
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Patients aged 65 or over had higher 30-day mortality (15.3% vs 4.9%).

result.other_findings: Greatest mortality reduction over time was in the oldest cohorts, possibly linked to more geriatrician input.

result.setting: Adult intensive treatment unit
result.standard: Benchmark infection rates; hand hygiene target 90%

cycle1.result: Infection rates above benchmark; hand hygiene adherence 80%.

result.intervention: In-hospital laundry of staff uniforms, multimodal hand hygiene campaign, aseptic technique training and higher quality ventilator filters

cycle2.result: Hand hygiene adherence 84% (below 90% target). CLABSI fell below benchmark; VAP fell markedly but not to benchmark; CAUTI fell further.

result.other_findings: Root cause analysis with fishbone and FOCUS-PDCA used.

result.topic: Medical student involvement in primary care QI
result.setting: Primary care
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Opinion piece: QI projects such as audits benefit both clinicians and students.

result.topic: Self-manageable dermatology presentations in primary care
result.setting: General practice (EMIS records)
result.standard: Criteria for self-management: OTC medication or reassurance

cycle1.result: 246/2175 (11.31%) consultations dermatological; 80/246 (32.5%) could be self-managed.

result.other_findings: No acne or mole cases were self-manageable; 23% of rashes, 68.2% of dermatitis and 72.7% of dry skin cases were.

result.setting: Bangholm GP Practice
result.standard: Faculty of Pain Medicine best-practice guidelines

cycle1.result: Initial consultation: 7% agreed outcomes, 35% follow-up documented. Review: 56% at 4 weeks, 70% in past year. 57% prescribed >5 years.

result.intervention: Patient information sheet, compulsory 1-month review for new patients on opioids, in-surgery pain referrals (introduced, not re-audited)
result.other_findings: 52% on tramadol, 23% on two opioids; back pain the commonest indication (42%); 28% registered with a repeat opioid prescription.

result.setting: New Queen Street and Stanground Surgeries, Peterborough
result.standard: NICE guidelines on secondary prevention of stroke/TIA

cycle1.result: 234/236 post-stroke/TIA patients received antithrombotic therapy unless contraindicated.

result.other_findings: Of 13 not on antithrombotics, bleeding risk was the reason in 10, no documented reason in 2; documentation of reasons was poor.

result.topic: Cancer diagnosis rates during COVID-19 lockdown
result.setting: Pathology unit of a secondary care hospital network, Macerata
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Cancer diagnoses fell by 39% in 2020 versus the 2018-2019 average; prostate (75%), bladder (66%) and colorectal (62%) fell most.

result.other_findings: Colorectal cancer flagged as carrying potentially important diagnostic delay.

result.topic: Faecal calprotectin pathway and colonoscopy referral
result.setting: York Teaching Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: York faecal calprotectin care pathway

cycle1.result: FC-related colonoscopy referrals 24%; number needed to colonoscope 6.8; median time to diagnosis 41 days.

result.intervention: Introduction of the York faecal calprotectin care pathway in primary care

cycle2.result: FC-related referrals 13%; number needed to colonoscope 3.8; estimated time to diagnosis 29 days.

result.other_findings: Primary care FC uptake increased fourfold; cost saving £41 015 per thousand patients tested.

result.topic: Mouth prop use in oral surgery under local anaesthesia
result.setting: Aintree University Hospital, Liverpool (minor oral surgery under LA)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 24 patients treated with mouth props and 23 without; patients reported less difficulty in mouth opening with a prop and similarly low discomfort. 95% who used a prop would recommend it.

result.other_findings: Surgeons and assistants found mouth opening less problematic and assisting easier with a prop.

result.topic: Computer-guided cardiovascular risk management in primary care
result.setting: Modelled New South Wales primary health network (TORPEDO trial data)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Major CVD events per 1000 high-risk patients over five years: 259 v 267 (secondary prevention) and 168 v 176 (primary prevention) with HealthTracker versus usual care. ICER $7406 (primary) and $17 988 (secondary) per event averted.

result.intervention: HealthTracker electronic decision support, clinical audit tool and performance feedback portal
result.other_findings: Modelled cost-effectiveness analysis, not an audit.

result.setting: Basic specialist psychiatry trainees
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 49/81 (60.5%) responded; 57.1% had formal audit training but only 20.4% more than four hours; median positivity score 30/54.

result.other_findings: Age, nationality, gender, experience and training did not predict attitudes to audit.

result.setting: Tertiary teaching hospital (Concord Repatriation General Hospital), acute adult inpatients
result.standard: Antimicrobial prescribing appropriateness compared with guidelines; documented indication

cycle1.result: Appropriateness 55%; documentation of indication 75%. Prevalence of antimicrobial therapy 37%.

result.intervention: Weekly AMS audit and feedback rounds covering all antimicrobials, using electronic medicines management

cycle2.result: Appropriateness 71%; documentation of indication 98%. 1413 recommendations made, 47% uptake at 24 h.

result.other_findings: Rounds took median 44 min with eMM versus 58 min on paper.

result.setting: Two UK tertiary centres
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: St Mark's incontinence score improved by a median of 6 points; about 50% achieved meaningful improvement. Firing device jammed in 30%.

result.other_findings: No intra-operative complications; clinical benefit unrelated to misplaced or migrated implants.

result.setting: Haematology and Oncology, Royal Hospital for Sick Children, Edinburgh (inpatient, day-care and outpatient)
result.standard: Department's own nutritional standards for paediatric cancer (anthropometry, biochemistry, malnutrition screening)

cycle1.result: 185 records audited (22 IP, 54 DC, 109 OP); results stratified by percentage of standard met; detailed figures not fully given in abstract.

result.other_findings: Baseline results only; areas for improvement included vitamin B12 and parathyroid hormone levels.

result.topic: Peer review in paediatric radiation oncology
result.setting: Fortnightly paediatric radiation oncology videoconference, Australia and New Zealand
result.standard: RANZCR Peer Review Audit Tool

cycle1.result: 334 children discussed at 119 meetings; 80% discussed before RT; management plan change recommended for 35/334 (13%); RT plan reviewed in 79 (23%), with adjustments in 6/79 (8%).

result.other_findings: Regular attendance from only four of 11 treating centres.

result.setting: Royal Eye Infirmary, University Hospitals Plymouth (outpatient cleanroom)
result.standard: Safety: endophthalmitis and visually significant complications; waiting time to injection

cycle1.result: Significant delay in injection delivery; waiting time 29.5 days.

result.intervention: Service moved from theatre to outpatient cleanroom and two senior nurse practitioners trained to inject

cycle2.result: No endophthalmitis (0%) or other visually significant complications; waiting time 15 days.

result.other_findings: One incomplete scleral penetration resolved without sequelae; patient satisfaction overwhelmingly positive.

result.setting: Acute children's and general hospitals in the National Cardiac Arrest Audit
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Sustained ROSC 69.1%; survival to discharge 54.2%.

result.other_findings: Children's hospitals had higher ROSC (79.1% vs 55.5%) and survival (57.7% vs 49.3%) than acute general hospitals.

result.setting: Two UK tertiary allergy clinics
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 73.6% of paediatric and 78% of adult patients were suspected to have multiple sensitisations; 70% of adults and 98% of children had another investigation before ISAC.

result.other_findings: ISAC testing mostly confirmed clinical suspicion; testing sequence varied greatly.

result.setting: Cork University Hospital and South Infirmary Victoria University Hospital
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 77% satisfied; mean IKDC 66.7, Lysholm 74.9; knee stable in 94.4%.

result.other_findings: Dissatisfaction rates remained quite high despite stability.

result.setting: Radiotherapy, Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: PTV margins 0.4, 0.4 and 0.7 cm (LR, SI, AP) registering to prostate; 0.3, 0.2 and 0.4 cm registering to bone.

result.other_findings: Posterior systematic shift of the prostate during treatment.

result.topic: Point of care ultrasound provision in acute medical units
result.setting: UK acute medical units (SAMBA day of care survey)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 75/129 (58.1%) AMUs had dedicated ultrasound equipment in SAMBA'19, a small increase from SAMBA'18.

result.other_findings: Ultrasound expertise concentrated in a small number of units; growth in trained clinicians greatest where expertise already existed.

result.setting: Large tertiary cardiac centre, Liverpool Heart and Chest Hospital
result.standard: Guidelines on reviewing and deactivating ICDs towards end of life

cycle1.result: Audit showed inadequate patient communication and documentation around deactivation.

result.intervention: Electronic records, clinical review of comorbid patients before elective battery change and patient and carer education forum

cycle2.result: Increased numbers of timely deactivations with improved documented patient discussion and consent (no figures in abstract).

result.other_findings: Educational forum was received favourably.

result.topic: Lung cancer nurse specialist working practices and outcomes
result.setting: English secondary care (National Lung Cancer Audit)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Nurse specialist assessment associated with lower hazard of death with radiotherapy only (HR 0.83) and surgery (HR 0.91).

result.other_findings: Assessments before/at diagnosis associated with 5% lower rate of unplanned admissions.

result.setting: One-stop breast clinic, Ninewells Hospital, Dundee
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 3 (4%) recalled after second radiologist review; 5 (7%) re-presented with same lump; 2 developed ipsilateral cancer at a different site.

result.other_findings: Minimum follow-up 12 months, mean 2 years; policy appeared safe.

result.topic: Urokinase for occluded central venous catheters
result.setting: Haematology and oncology units in eight centres
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Patency restored in 80% of partial withdrawal occlusions and 88% of total occlusions; 83%, 89% and 92% with 5000, 10 000 and 25 000 IU.

result.other_findings: No adverse events recorded.

result.setting: 22 UK centres (BAUS Penile Prosthesis National Audit)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Inflatable prostheses 62.1%, malleable 14.2%; intra-operative urethral injury 0.7%, corporal perforation 1.1%, cross-over 0.6%; postoperative complications 9.8% (74/752).

result.other_findings: Fewer surgeons and fewer centres performing the procedure over the period.

result.topic: Discrepancy rates in acute abdominal CT reporting
result.setting: Large university teaching hospital, Leicester
result.standard: National audit standard for major discrepancy rates

cycle1.result: Major discrepancy rate 6.86% for registrars versus 2.77% for consultants; both below the national audit standard.

result.other_findings: Lower discrepancy associated with consultant and GI radiologist reporting and preoperative radiologist-surgeon discussion.

result.setting: Radiotherapy CT (Canon Aquilion Prime), Portsmouth Hospitals NHS Trust
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 14 Catphan phantoms scanned; mean uniformity CT value 7.0 HU (range 4.9-8.1); model 604 showed minimal differences.

result.other_findings: Technical phantom study to prepare a future multi-centre image quality audit.

result.setting: Tertiary pain medicine clinic, University Hospitals of Leicester
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 162/207 (78%) on opioids at presentation with significant reduction at 12 months or more. Of 180 having interventions, durable relief 40%, cure 15%; treatment failure 15%.

result.other_findings: Structured management pathway; single-centre open-label design.

result.setting: East London endoscopy ward, Newham University Hospital
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: A little more than 20% of participants were inadequately prepared; no relationship with language proficiency or ethnicity.

result.other_findings: Almost one-third had limited English; interpreters were usually family members or staff.

result.topic: Mental health assessment rooms in emergency departments
result.setting: 26 adult 24/7 emergency departments
result.standard: Psychiatric Liaison Accreditation Network (PLAN) standards; target 100% compliance

cycle1.result: 100% response; full or substantial compliance with PLAN standards in 73% of services; rooms unsuitable in seven services; ligature points identified in some.

result.intervention: Recommendations (ligature and room risk assessments) sent to hospital group chief executives
result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Acute kidney injury post-discharge care in primary care
result.setting: 45 general practices in Salford (PINGR dashboard)
result.standard: Six quality indicators from national guidance on post-discharge AKI care

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Electronic audit and feedback dashboard (PINGR) for six months

cycle2.result: Improvement in medication review (+9.01%) and blood pressure measurement (+5.20%); no clear change in AKI coding (+0.39%), serum creatinine (-3.40%), proteinuria (-1.08%) or patient information (+0.16%).

result.other_findings: Champions of change aided engagement; barriers were indicator specificity and limited resources.

result.topic: Antibiotic indication and 48-72 hour review documentation
result.setting: NHS hospital trusts in England (PHE AMS surveillance system)
result.standard: NHS AMR CQUIN: documentation of indication and 48-72 hour review

cycle1.result: 33 trusts: on average 83% of patients had an indication documented and 71% had formal 48-72 h review documented.

result.intervention: Refined national surveillance system linked to AMR CQUIN financial incentive

cycle2.result: About 92% of prescriptions had an indication documented and 87.5% had review within 72 h, rising by 7 and 10 percentage points between first and final quarters.

result.other_findings: 88% of trusts submitted CQUIN data for at least one quarter; data published openly on PHE Fingertips.

result.setting: DECAF internal validation cohort, Royal Victoria Infirmary, Newcastle
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 717/1122 (64%) patients with an ECOPD code had confirmed ECOPD; broad search found 297 additional missed cases.

result.other_findings: Most missed cases had pneumonia complicating ECOPD.

result.topic: Emergency department return visits with admission
result.setting: 86 high-volume emergency departments in Ontario (mandatory provincial programme)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 125 698 return visits with admission (0.93% of visits); 12 852 chart audits found 3010 (23.4%) adverse events or quality issues.

result.other_findings: 11 recurrent quality themes identified across patient, ED team and system factors.

result.topic: Laparoscopic versus open perforated peptic ulcer repair
result.setting: National Emergency Laparotomy Audit hospitals
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 90-day mortality 7.2% laparoscopic vs 8.5% open (P = 0.23); no difference in LOS, reoperation or critical care readmission.

result.other_findings: Laparoscopic use rose from 20% to 26% and conversion fell from 40% to 31%.

result.topic: Acute medical unit clinical quality indicators
result.setting: 142 units in 140 UK hospitals (SAMBA19)
result.standard: Society for Acute Medicine Clinical Quality Indicators

cycle1.result: EWS within 30 minutes 84.5% (SAMBA18 84.1%); seen by competent decision maker within 4 hours 90.4% (91.4%); consultant review within standard 68.6% (62.7%).

result.other_findings: Ambulatory emergency care in 99.3% of hospitals; NEWS2 use rose from 2.5% to 59.2% of hospitals.

result.topic: Diagnosis of medullary carcinoma of the colon
result.setting: Histopathology, Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust
result.standard: WHO criteria for medullary carcinoma

cycle1.result: Only one-third of medullary carcinomas were correctly identified; two-thirds reported as poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma NOS.

result.other_findings: Extracolonic origin or neuroendocrine carcinoma considered in 21% and 27% of reports.

result.topic: Advance care planning in adolescents and young adults with cancer
result.setting: Regional specialist centre, University Hospitals Birmingham
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: ACP identified for 67%; 64% expressed a preferred place of death, achieved in 65%.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Surgical margins after head and neck cancer surgery
result.setting: UK oral and maxillofacial surgical units (clinical audit dataset), East Kent
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Positive margins (<1 mm) varied between units from 19% to 29%; Naive Bayes risk model AUROC 0.72.

result.other_findings: Risk-adjusted margin rates presented on a funnel plot for benchmarking.

result.topic: Guideline-directed medical therapy at heart failure discharge
result.setting: Eight hospitals in Kerala
result.standard: Guideline-directed medical therapy at discharge for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

cycle1.result: Guideline-directed therapy at discharge 28.1% in the control period.

result.intervention: Quality improvement toolkit: checklists, audit and feedback reports and patient education materials

cycle2.result: 41.3% in the intervention period (difference 13.2%, adjusted OR 1.70).

result.other_findings: Effect highest in initial weeks then declined; no change in length of stay or inpatient mortality.

result.topic: Healthy food and drink availability in hospital outlets
result.setting: Food outlet in a dental teaching hospital, London
result.standard: NHS England CQUIN 1b (e.g. 80% of drinks under 5 g sugar/100 ml)

cycle1.result: Only cold and hot drinks met the 80% sugar target; a third of packaged biscuits and 50% of cakes and pastries exceeded 250 kcal per portion.

result.other_findings: HFSS products were displayed at the checkout; packaged fruit cost more than biscuits.

result.topic: Intravesical chemotherapy after bladder tumour resection
result.setting: Seven hospitals in Scotland and England; cross-sectional qualitative study with 30 urology staff interviewed
result.standard: International guidance on single instillation of intravesical chemotherapy after NMIBC resection

cycle1.result: Barriers identified: four hospitals had a policy not to instil in theatre; six reported delays in mitomycin C ordering or storage; lack of training, skills and perceived workload. Facilitators: modern instilling devices (four hospitals) and reminders in operation proforma (four hospitals).

result.other_findings: Performance targets with audit and feedback existed in Scotland but not England; theory-informed interview study rather than a compliance audit.

result.setting: 750-bed acute secondary care hospital; single-centre process audit of medical inpatients
result.standard: NICE guidance on antibiotic course length for common infections (CAP, HAP, pyelonephritis, cellulitis, IECOPD, cholangitis)

cycle1.result: 423 eligible; 307 (73%) notes reviewed; 173 met case definitions, 137 met short-course criteria. Potential antibiotic reductions (DDD): 32% in CAP, 20% in HAP, 14% in IECOPD, 11% in cellulitis, 10% in pyelonephritis.

result.other_findings: Reductions estimated to cut total antibiotic use in medical specialties by 12.4%, equal to 3.6% of hospital total antibiotic use.

result.topic: Ototoxicity monitoring in children on platinum chemotherapy
result.setting: Audiology departments linked to 19 national paediatric cancer specialist centres; questionnaire survey
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 17 of 19 centres (89%) responded; all offered audiometric monitoring; extended high-frequency testing used by 7 services (29%); 9 (53%) reluctant to use self-test devices; only 4 (23%) kept all children with normal hearing under review after treatment.

result.other_findings: Long-term audiological follow-up was sporadic.

result.setting: Department of Surgery, Royal Devon and Exeter Hospital; consecutive case series
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 9% no operation, 27% incurable at laparotomy, 64% resection; R1 gastrectomy in 73 of 78 resections; operative mortality after resection 4%; actuarial 5-year survival 20% overall, 60% curative N0, 18% N1.

result.other_findings: Only 6% had early gastric cancer; locoregional recurrence in 11% after curative resection; N1 disease (P<0.005) and poor differentiation (P<0.001) worsened survival.

result.setting: Elderly care wards, district general hospital in Kent; quality improvement project
result.standard: Preventive measures: bedhead raised to 30 degrees, sitting out for meals, avoiding drinking straws, regular mouth care

cycle1.result: Three audit cycles over 6 months totalling 222 inpatients; baseline figures not reported in abstract.

result.intervention: Interventions between cycles promoting raising bedheads to 30 degrees, sitting patients out of bed for meals, discouraging straws and regular mouth care

cycle2.result: Improvement in three measures: 23% increase in patients with bedheads >30 degrees, 21% increase in use of adult feeding cups rather than straws, 26% rise in patients sitting out of bed for meals.

result.other_findings: Three audit cycles in total (222 patients over 6 months); mouth care improvement not reported.

result.setting: International Pharmacists for Anticoagulation Care Taskforce; online survey of 22 countries
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Responses from all 22 countries; most reported general services were transfer of care and comprehensive medication review; point-of-care INR and renal function testing and patient education were the most frequent specific services.

result.other_findings: Use of Choosing Wisely to inform decisions was limited; wide diversity in service arrangements.

result.topic: Models of care in cardiac genetics clinics
result.setting: Multidisciplinary cardiac genetics clinics at 11 public tertiary hospitals in five Australian states; national records audit
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 90% clinic, 6% inpatient, 4% telehealth consultations; 85% referred by cardiologists; 73% of tests funded by state Genetic Health Service; 29% of genetic tests found a pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant.

result.other_findings: Descriptive baseline of practice to inform genome sequencing implementation; not measured against a standard.

result.setting: UK radiotherapy departments; national audit of patients starting adjuvant breast radiotherapy over 2 weeks
result.standard: 2016 Royal College of Radiologists consensus statements and 2018 NICE guidelines for breast radiotherapy

cycle1.result: 81% of centres returned data; 40 Gy in 15 fractions used in 95.7%; 29.9% of 743 breast conservation cases had a boost; 54% (267/494) left-sided cases treated in deep inspiratory breath hold; 12% eligible received partial breast irradiation; 14.7% (RCR) and 9.9% (NICE) eligible received internal mammary chain radiotherapy.

result.other_findings: Boost was sequential in 91.9% with eight different fractionation schedules; all but one centre had breath hold technique available.

result.topic: Appropriateness of imaging requests in trauma
result.setting: Level 1 adult trauma centre emergency department, Westmead Hospital; retrospective audit
result.standard: American College of Radiology/European Society of Radiology imaging guidelines

cycle1.result: 642 imaging decisions for 370 trauma cases; non-compliance was low. Non-compliant orders leading to change in management: JMOs 11 (65%), SRMOs 25 (53%), EMRs 12 (63%), consultants 11 (52%).

result.other_findings: JMOs and SRMOs ordered more non-compliant imaging for conservatively managed than surgically managed patients.

result.topic: CAMHS referral journey and routine outcome measures
result.setting: Bath and North East Somerset, Swindon and Wiltshire CAMHS; prospective audit of consecutive accepted referrals
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Across audits 90% of those offered an appointment were seen, three quarters completing baseline ROMS; paired ROMS obtained for 46% to 60% of closed cases.

cycle2.result: Similar results; about 30% still open at end of each audit; few changes in referral problems or complexity.

result.other_findings: One in three were not seen again after the first appointment.

result.topic: Patient experience of old age psychiatry service
result.setting: Rural Psychiatry of Later Life service, west of Ireland; postal questionnaire audit of new referrals
result.standard: Team standards based on local and national policies (HSE Vision for Change)

cycle1.result: Not reported separately in abstract.

result.intervention: Disabled parking access resolved; service information leaflet and discharge leaflet developed

cycle2.result: More than 90% of patients reported benefit from the service; negative responses about disabled parking, discharge planning and unresolved symptoms in a few patients.

result.other_findings: Audit repeated four times (2012, 2013, 2016, 2019); future focus on psychoeducation and discharge planning.

result.setting: 33 imaging protocols across 27 CT scanners in a large UK region; regional dose audit
result.standard: National diagnostic reference levels for CT colonography (11 mGy CTDIvol and 950 mGy.cm DLP)

cycle1.result: Regional DRLs: contrast-enhanced CTDIvol 11 and 5 mGy, DLP 740 mGy.cm; unenhanced 5 mGy and 450 mGy.cm; all compliant with national DRLs.

result.other_findings: Marked variation in dose and technique between similar scanners; authors suggest the national DRL is too high.

result.setting: Congenital Cardiac Research Collaborative, nine US institutions; remote source data verification audit
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 58 of 572 patients verified; 45 discrepancies in 1790 variables; overall accuracy 97.5% (range 94.6% to 99.4% across institutions); minor discrepancies 1.5%, major 1.1%.

result.other_findings: Research dataset verification rather than clinical practice audit.

result.setting: BAUS radical prostatectomy audit linked to National Prostate Cancer Audit HES database
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: BAUS completeness higher for nerve-sparing (92% vs 42%) and margin status (89% vs 48%), lower for readmission (87% vs 100%) and Charlson score (80% vs 100%); agreement high for most variables.

result.other_findings: Reliability poor for readmission, M stage and Charlson score.

result.topic: Communities of practice for evidence into practice
result.setting: Three Evidence into Practice groups in primary and secondary care, Keele and Midlands
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Groups engaged over 180 staff, answered 130 clinical questions and gained funding for two randomised trials.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Neonatal and infant anaesthesia morbidity and mortality
result.setting: 165 centres in 31 European countries; prospective multicentre observational study (NECTARINE)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 5609 infants underwent 6542 procedures; critical events requiring intervention occurred in 35.2% of cases, mainly hypotension or reduced oxygenation.

result.other_findings: Variability in physiological thresholds triggering intervention; authors call for standardised perioperative guidelines.

result.topic: Safety of inter-hospital critical care transfers
result.setting: Intensive Care Unit, Heartlands Hospital, University Hospitals Birmingham; ACCP-led transfer service review
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 934 critical care transfers of ventilated patients including 286 inter-hospital transfers; 82.2% needed more than one organ supported, 49% needed >50% oxygen; uneventful transfer in 81.4%.

result.other_findings: Hypotension was the commonest patient-related complication; logistical issues caused half of complications.

result.topic: Small cell lung cancer survival factors
result.setting: English national lung cancer audit, chemotherapy and radiotherapy data; retrospective cohort
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Male sex, older age, comorbidity, extensive stage and worse performance status associated with reduced 1-year survival; in 1761 treated with chemotherapy, thoracic radiotherapy and PCI associated with better survival (P<=0.01) but 6 vs 4 cycles was not.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Queen Mother Hospital for Small Animals, Royal Veterinary College; retrospective single-centre audit with hypothetical model
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 14,370 minutes audited; 43,132 L oxygen used to vaporise 2605 mL sevoflurane and 1654 mL isoflurane; carbon footprint 1.82 tonnes CO2e.

result.other_findings: Modelled low-flow technique could cut oxygen to 16,798 L and agent use in 97% of anaesthetics (median 59% reduction), lowering footprint to 0.67 tonnes (63% reduction).

result.setting: Two group general practices in a city health centre, Belfast; computerised audit
result.standard: Practice decision to prescribe NSAIDs in generic form from an agreed date

cycle1.result: Generic prescribing at baseline 4% and 1% of NSAID repeat prescriptions in the two practices.

result.intervention: Agreed changeover to generic NSAID prescribing, monitored by practice computer

cycle2.result: Generic prescribing rose to 64% in one practice and 38% in the other.

result.other_findings: Considerable variation between the two practices.

result.setting: Single general practice, rural New South Wales; retrospective clinical audit
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Average annual catch-up vaccination incidence 6.2% before policy.

result.intervention: Federal 'No Jab, No Pay' policy introduced January 2016
result.other_findings: Increases in ages 8-11, 12-15 and 16-19 years; reduction in ages 1-3 years (11.4% to 6.2%, p=.015); DTPa catch-up rose.

result.setting: NHS Business Services Authority prescribing data, England
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Average monthly wound-care expenditure per patient £244.

result.intervention: Prescription of monofilament fibre debridement pad

cycle2.result: Average monthly expenditure £209 per patient; total wound-care prescribing cost fell by 14% (£101,723).

result.other_findings: Cost analysis of a product rather than audit against a standard.

result.setting: NHS general dental practices, North London; feasibility trial data
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 46% of dental patients drank at hazardous levels on AUDIT-C.

result.other_findings: Males, younger adults, weekly red meat eaters and smokers had higher risk of excessive drinking.

result.setting: Published orthodontic clinical audits 2013-2019
result.standard: Audit reporting checklist (score 9 or more good, 5-8 fair, 4 or less poor)

cycle1.result: 159 audits; mean score 10.1 (SD 1.5); scores improved from 2015 after a submission template was introduced.

result.other_findings: Multi-cycle audits scored higher (coef 2.0, p<0.001); partial audits scored lower (coef -1.8, p<0.001).

result.setting: UK five-year cleft audit clinics
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 100 UCLP and 42 BCLP children; no association between dental arch relationship and audiology or speech outcomes; some psychology domains associated (P=.018, P=.01).

result.other_findings: Deprivation index was not associated with the outcomes assessed.

result.topic: Infection after corticosteroid injection for chronic pain
result.setting: Multidisciplinary pain medicine centre, university teaching hospital, Leicester; prospective longitudinal audit
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Infection within 4 weeks in 9/261 (3.4%); none tested positive for Covid-19; 8/261 (3%) infection at 5-12 weeks.

result.other_findings: At 12 weeks durable analgesia 51% (133/261), clinically significant 30% (78/261), failure 19% (50/261).

result.setting: Pathology department, Queen Elizabeth University Hospital, Glasgow
result.standard: Royal College of Pathologists audit templates; adequacy = length >15 mm and/or 6 or more portal tracts

cycle1.result: 53/57 (93%) core biopsies met RCPath adequacy criteria; 57/60 (95%) reports helped management; 25/60 (42%) clarified diagnosis; 48/60 (80%) led to altered management.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Community special care dentistry and dental hospital oral surgery services, Sheffield; multi-centre retrospective audit
result.standard: National Patient Safety Agency (2008) advice against routine reliance on flumazenil; agreed standard for flumazenil use

cycle1.result: Flumazenil used very infrequently and far below the agreed standard; dose and justification recorded in all records.

result.other_findings: Most uses supported the escort journey home, not always pre-planned; variation in record-keeping.

result.setting: UK 5-year audit outcomes submitted to Cleft Registry and Audit Network (CRANE)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 92 UCLP and 39 BCLP children; dmft >0 in 47% and 49%; mean dmft 2.8 and 2.6. In UCLP a poorer 5-year-old index was associated with higher dmft (P=.023) and deprivation (P=.010).

result.other_findings: No significant associations in the BCLP group.

result.setting: Psychiatric intensive care unit (OAK ward), Phoenix Care Centre, Dublin
result.standard: Structured tool of forensic history items developed from literature

cycle1.result: Drug and alcohol history documented in 98%, previous charges 88%, protection/barring order 62%, previous police encounters without charge 32%.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Postpartum diabetes screening after gestational diabetes
result.setting: University Hospitals of the North Midlands, Stoke-on-Trent; retrospective audit of hospital records
result.standard: UK guidance: screening for type 2 diabetes around 6 weeks postpartum and annually thereafter

cycle1.result: 59.8% of women had the recommended postpartum testing.

cycle2.result: 35.0% of women had the recommended postpartum testing.

result.other_findings: Two separate cohorts rather than a re-audit after a change; many women lacked adequate short- and long-term screening.

result.setting: South Wing Eye Department, St Thomas's Hospital, London; retrospective review of case records
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: No significant change in proportion achieving corrected acuity 6/12 or better at three months as extracapsular techniques and lens implants were introduced.

result.other_findings: Fall in raised intraocular pressure; 13% visually disabling posterior capsular thickening after extracapsular extraction; downward trend in vitreous loss.

result.topic: Emergency department ultrasound use and credentialing
result.setting: Emergency departments of eight major public hospitals, greater metropolitan Brisbane; questionnaire of physicians
result.standard: Australasian College for Emergency Medicine five core ultrasound applications

cycle1.result: 94.4% participated; 90% used ultrasound for venous access, E-FAST 69%, AAA 51%, lung 40%, BELS 29%; only 33% had skills assessed by a qualified person for any application.

result.other_findings: 98% favoured enhanced departmental training.

result.topic: Antimicrobial stewardship strategies in primary care
result.setting: Medicines management teams of all 209 clinical commissioning groups in England; questionnaire
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 187/209 (89%) responded; 74% (123/167) had a prescribing incentive scheme; AMS audits considered successful by 91% (126/138); all fed back prescribing data to practices, 85% to boards, only 33% (56/169) to out-of-hours services.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Teaching hospital, Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust, London; 12-month retrospective audit
result.standard: British Thoracic Society Asthma Discharge Care Bundle

cycle1.result: Hospital complied with the bundle overall; 85% had inhaler technique checked but 62% were given no written inhaler instructions.

result.other_findings: Respiratory nurse specialists were more compliant with most bundle statements than the medical team; education on record-keeping recommended.

result.topic: Retinopathy of prematurity retinal detachment surgery outcomes
result.setting: Oxford Eye Hospital, John Radcliffe Hospital; consecutive operations from surgical log
result.standard: Comparison with two international data sets (including ETROP)

cycle1.result: 29 eyes of 19 babies; anatomical success in 16/29 (55.2%), more likely with stage 4 than stage 5 disease.

result.other_findings: Authors conclude surgery for stage 5 ROP is not worthwhile and call for a national service.

result.setting: Association of Surgeons in Primary Care annual vasectomy audit database, UK
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Compliance with PVSA 79.5% for postal vs 59.1% for non-postal strategy (difference 20.4%, 95% CI 19.7% to 21.2%).

result.other_findings: Early failure detection 0.73% postal vs 0.94% non-postal; no difference in late failure.

result.setting: Department of Paediatric Surgery, Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital, Mumbai; retrospective case series
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 77% (50/65) genitourinary reconstructions; mean console time 95 minutes (45-327); one conversion to open; no major complications.

result.other_findings: Console time improved progressively over time.

result.topic: Enhanced recovery after ovarian cancer surgery
result.setting: Gynaecology departments of St George's Hospital, UK, and Aga Khan University Hospital, Pakistan; retrospective cross-sectional comparison
result.standard: Enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocol

cycle1.result: 50 patients per centre; mechanical bowel preparation in 47 (94%) of Pakistani patients vs 1 (2%) in the ERAS unit; nil-by-mouth duration, nasogastric tube and drain use differed significantly.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: 27 Australasian GPs contributing to the Skin Cancer Audit Research Database
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 59.7% of melanomas on males; mean age 62.7 years; 65.0% in situ; lentiginous melanoma 38.8%; 32% naevus-associated.

result.other_findings: Nodular melanoma linked to death was over-represented; older patients had larger diameter melanomas.

result.topic: Decision-to-delivery interval for category 1 caesarean section
